title: the first-day help: a page per role and seven procedures in en, ja and zh-TW
note: basis 'shown' means shown by reading the code and by the card's tests; nothing was run against a real box.

findings.claim: the restore procedure says the console does not restore a backup and that hospital IT restores from the host; this is taken from the Backups tab's own drill text (ops.drill.cli), not from a restore run

the first-night procedure says a first night without a backup key shows a warning on Information still needed and goes on; the code shows the key as a need before the first real run (site_needs backup_key), but no test here runs a first night without one
the ja and zh-TW procedure words were written for this card and not read by a native clinical reader; the terms to check are in the hand-back
